name: com.app2email/whatsapp
title: app2email WhatsApp
description: Send WhatsApp Business templates and replies, read conversations and manage contacts via app2email.

environmentVariables.name: APP2EMAIL_NUMBER
environmentVariables.description: The WhatsApp number messages are sent from: country code first, digits only, eg 4976659348270

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your app2email API key>. The key identifies the WhatsApp number. Not needed with OAuth: a client that supports it signs in to app2email instead.
